name: Waymo Open Motion Dataset
description: Large-scale interactive motion forecasting dataset derived from over 570 hours of real-world autonomous driving recordings across diverse US urban environments. Provides 103,354 20-second segments at 10 Hz (over 20 million frames) with 3D map data and 10.8M tracked objects, partitioned into official proportions of 70% training, 15% validation, and 15% testing, with overlapping mined interactive motion forecasting scenarios for benchmark evaluation.

provenance.collection_method: Mined from over 570 hours of real-world autonomous driving recordings across diverse US urban environments; filtered for dense, highly interactive driving scenarios involving multi-agent yielding, lane changes, unprotected turns, and pedestrian crossings.
provenance.curation_notes: Officially updated in October 2025 (v1.3.1 sdc_paths). Comprises 103,354 20-second segments (574 hours of data, over 20M frames at 10 Hz) divided according to official split proportions into 70% train, 15% validation, and 15% test. The 103,354 segments are distinct from the ~487,000 overlapping interactive scenario windows mined for motion forecasting challenges.
